name: Pattern Playlist Arrangements
author: Freek van Gool
description: Layered arrangements for Pattern Playlist: every layer (kick, snare, hats, bass, chords, lead, pad, arp, perc) is its own pattern placed as blocks on a timeline, so sections build by adding and removing layers. Tracks: 1 kick, 2 snare/clap, 3 hats, 4 bass, 5 chords, 6 lead, 7 pad/arp, 8 percussion. Connect tracks 1, 2, 3 and 8 to a drum machine (GM-style notes: kick 36, snare 38, clap 39, rim 37, closed hat 42, open hat 46) and the others to synths. Genres: dance, bass music, hip-hop and soul, song forms, ambient and cinematic.
